distance_definition: Number of agent/user turns after the clue and before fast-forward; includes the evaluated pre-gap action and user acknowledgement.
clue: Worth knowing: the building changed managing agents at the start of the quarter.
clue_ablation_text: No, nothing has changed about who looks after the building.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, the heating in my flat has not worked for three days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about that. Can you confirm the flat number?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it is flat twelve on the third floor.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a buzzer at the main entrance?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, there is one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would you like a text before anyone arrives?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, a text would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Have you checked the thermostat setting?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, it is turned right up.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Does the hot water still run?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, the water is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there a boiler cupboard inside the flat?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, in the hallway.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is it the whole flat or one room?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The whole flat is cold.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are neighbours reporting the same problem?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One of them mentioned it too.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is the number ending in nine-zero-six still right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, that is my number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would daytime access be possible?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes, I work from home.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has anything changed about who looks after the building?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Worth knowing: the building changed managing agents at the start of the quarter.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Raise the job and send it to the contractor rota.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I will wait for someone to come.

pre_gap_actions.description: Raise the job and send it to the contractor rota.
Move the tenant elsewhere before any visit is attempted.
Approve a complete new heating system immediately.
Post out portable heaters and leave it there.
Close the request and ask the tenant to report it again.

post_gap_actions.description: Get fresh entry permissions issued for whoever now holds the contract.
Send the same job to the contractor rota again now.
Leave the job alone and wait another interval.
Close the request because the visit interval has passed.

response_styles.description: Briefly acknowledge the user's impact or urgency before proceeding.
Proceed directly and neutrally to the next operational step.

questions.question: Does the hot water still run?
Why did the visit fail?
questions.gold_answer: the contractor could not get access

tag_definitions.EARLY_CLUE_LOSS: The selected action is attractive when the early clue is unavailable or unused.
tag_definitions.STATE_SYNC_FAILURE: The action treats the pre-gap world as if it still held after time advanced.
tag_definitions.TIME_INFERENCE_FAILURE: The action fails to use elapsed time when interpreting the observation.
tag_definitions.REPEATED_ACTION: The action repeats a step already attempted without a new justification.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_CLOSE: The action closes an interaction whose state is unresolved.
tag_definitions.PREMATURE_ESCALATION: The action escalates before supported diagnostic or policy steps are exhausted.
tag_definitions.ACTION_SELECTION_FAILURE: The action is inconsistent with the current state but has no narrower failure label.
tag_definitions.PROSODY_GROUNDING_FAILURE: The response approach does not match the audible delivery.
tag_definitions.BELIEF_REPORT_INVALID: One or more required state-belief distributions or revalidation flags are missing or malformed.
tag_definitions.STATE_BELIEF_ERROR: At least one required checkpoint assigns its highest probability to the wrong hidden state.
